props.title: What Is a Head Massage?
props.text: A head massage is a wellness treatment that focuses on the scalp, temples, neck, and upper shoulders using slow, rhythmic massage techniques. While commonly chosen for relaxation, it also helps ease muscle tightness around the head and neck caused by prolonged sitting, screen time, travelling, or everyday stress.
props.feature1Text: Gentle movements help reduce tightness around the scalp and temples.
props.feature2Text: Supports relaxation in the upper neck and shoulder muscles.

props.title: Our Duration Options
props.text: Our head massage comes in 30 minutes, 1 hour, 1.5 hours or 2 hours, adjusted to the pressure you like and the areas that need extra attention. The 30-minute head massage is also part of one of our packages, with a 1.5-hour hot stone massage and a 30-minute body scrub.

items.question: Can a head massage help with stress?
items.answer: Yes, for many guests: the slow, repetitive strokes of a head massage at Spa Bali Moon are relaxing and ease physical and mental tension. The therapist works across the scalp, temples, neck and upper shoulders.

items.question: Is oil used in a head massage?
items.answer: It's your choice: a head massage at Spa Bali Moon can be done with or without massage oil. Say which you prefer during the brief consultation before treatment.

items.question: Can a head massage help after long hours at a computer?
items.answer: Yes. Prolonged screen time often creates tension around the neck, shoulders and scalp, and a head massage at Spa Bali Moon focuses on these areas to improve overall comfort. Your therapist uses rhythmic movements across the scalp, circular pressure around the temples and massage of the neck and upper shoulders, with pressure adjusted to your comfort.

items.question: Is a head massage good before bed?
items.answer: Yes, many guests enjoy a head massage at Spa Bali Moon in the evening because the relaxing techniques help the body unwind before rest. Our Seminyak spa is open daily until 11pm, and our therapists can also come to your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I have a head massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen, oils and everything a head massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can a head massage help my hair grow?
items.answer: Not directly: there is limited evidence that head massage promotes hair growth. It relaxes the scalp and can be a soothing addition to your hair and scalp care routine. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, a head massage covers the scalp, temples, neck and upper shoulders.

items.question: Why does a head massage feel so good?
items.answer: It relaxes the muscles of the scalp and neck, and the slow, rhythmic pressure is calming. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, your therapist adjusts the pressure throughout and finishes with gentle movements.

items.question: How much does a head massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A head massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 90.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 159.000 for 1 hour, IDR 239.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 330.000 for 2 hours per person. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. You can pay by Visa, Mastercard or cash, and book on WhatsApp, 9am to 11pm daily.

items.question: How long does a head massage take?
items.answer: A head massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 30 minutes (IDR 90.000), 1 hour (IDR 159.000), 1.5 hours (IDR 239.000) or 2 hours (IDR 330.000) per person.

items.question: Can I book a head massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my head massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your head massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

props.text: Travel, screens, and busy days concentrate tension around the head and neck. A head massage releases it without committing to a full-body treatment. At our spa, or through home service.
